$comment: Agents are ACP adapters launched over stdio, each using its vendor CLI's own login. Roles pick an agent by name. "provides" says what an agent can do (web, shell); roles that need more are refused before a run starts. A profile can give any role, including a pipeline step by its id, another agent.

claude.note: Claude Code. Loads your own Claude settings, skills and plugins (~/.claude), like the CLI does.

claude-isolated.note: Claude Code without your user-level skills, plugins, hooks and CLAUDE.md: only the run's project settings and DevCrew's instructions. Use it for fair comparisons with other vendors.

claude-sonnet.note: Claude Sonnet 5.5, isolated like claude-isolated (no user-level skills, plugins, hooks or CLAUDE.md). Adapter version pinned for benchmarks.

claude-haiku.note: Claude Haiku 5.5, isolated like claude-isolated. Adapter version pinned for benchmarks.

codex.note: Codex CLI. Web search is not assumed: give roles that need the web another agent.

agy.note: Antigravity CLI (agy) through the google-antigravity-acp adapter (third-party, MIT, same one vscode-acp uses). Needs agy on PATH and logged in. The adapter auto-approves agy tool calls; DevCrew guards file scope. Version pinned for benchmarks. agents/agy-no-print-timeout.sh lifts the adapter fixed 60-min agy timeout; DevCrew enforces its own limits.

profileNotes.claude: Real Claude Code agents. Uses your subscription quota.
profileNotes.cross-vendor: Real agents: Claude plans and builds, Codex writes tests and reviews. Uses both quotas.
profileNotes.fake: Demo, no quota. Small shopping-cart project (4 files). Use project folder bench/tasks/S-01-cart/seed.
profileNotes.claude-isolated: Real Claude Code agents without your personal skills, plugins and CLAUDE.md. Use it for benchmarks against other vendors. Uses your subscription quota.
profileNotes.agy: Real Antigravity agents (Gemini 3.8 Flash High) for every role, including the security step. Uses your Antigravity quota.
profileNotes.fake-crash: Harness test, no quota. The Planner leaves a background command running and Dev's agent crashes mid-turn, so the run fails and every agent must still be stopped.
profileNotes.claude-sonnet: Claude Sonnet 5.5 for every role, isolated from your own Claude setup. Used for the evolution benchmark.
profileNotes.claude-haiku: Claude Haiku 5.5 for every role, isolated from your own Claude setup: the smaller, cheaper model. The Architect of a fast-arch pipeline uses Claude Sonnet 5.5: research finds stronger models design and maintain code better, and weak models gain most from a clear design.
profileNotes.fake-archchange: Harness test, no quota, for fast-arch. The Builder asks for an architecture change; the Architect changes the design, it is approved, and the Builder carries on.

$isolatedNote: claude-isolated copies ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and the model from ~/.claude/settings.json (it no longer reads that file). Update both here if you change them there.
